articles.title: Deep Ocean Mission: Strategic Progress in Central Indian Ocean Basin Exploration
articles.summary: India advances its deep-sea exploration capabilities targeting Polymetallic Nodules and rare earth minerals in the Indian Ocean.
prelims: Polymetallic Nodules (PMN) in the Central Indian Ocean Basin contain copper, nickel, cobalt, and manganese.
International Seabed Authority (ISA) regulates mineral exploration in international waters under UNCLOS.
MATSYA 6000 is India's indigenously developed crewed submersible under the Deep Ocean Mission implemented by the Ministry of Earth Sciences.
articles.mains: Examine the geopolitical and economic significance of deep-sea mining for India's critical mineral security and global energy transition.

articles.title: Global Biofuels Alliance: Standardization Guidelines for Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF)
articles.summary: The Global Biofuels Alliance introduces unified technical standards to accelerate Sustainable Aviation Fuel adoption across emerging economies.
prelims: Global Biofuels Alliance (GBA) was launched during India's G20 Presidency by India, the US, and Brazil.
Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) reduces lifecycle greenhouse gas emissions by up to 80% compared to conventional jet fuel.
ICAO's Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation (CORSIA) sets global targets for aviation decarbonization.
articles.mains: Discuss how biofuel integration in the aviation sector can help India fulfill its Net Zero 2070 commitments while addressing agricultural feedstock challenges.

articles.title: Expansion of Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM) with Open Health Protocols
articles.summary: The Ministry of Health operationalizes the Unified Health Interface (UHI) protocol to improve last-mile healthcare access in rural districts.
prelims: Ayushman Bharat Health Account (ABHA) assigns a 14-digit unique identifier for digital health record integration.
Unified Health Interface (UHI) acts as an open network protocol for digital health services, modeled on UPI.
Tele-MANAS provides 24/7 free tele-mental health services across all Indian States and Union Territories.
articles.mains: Analyze the role of Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) in bridging the urban-rural healthcare divide and advancing Universal Health Coverage in India.

articles.title: Regulatory Framework for CRISPR-Cas9 Gene-Edited Crop Varieties
articles.summary: ICAR guidelines streamline biosafety evaluations for SDN-1 and SDN-2 genome-edited climate-resilient staple crops.
prelims: Site-Directed Nuclease (SDN-1 and SDN-2) techniques do not introduce foreign genetic material, unlike traditional Genetically Modified Organisms (GMOs).
Genetic Engineering Appraisal Committee (GEAC) under MoEFCC is the apex body regulating GMO releases in India.
Genome editing selectively modifies endogenous DNA sequences to improve traits like drought and salinity tolerance.
articles.mains: Evaluate the potential of genome-edited crops in ensuring food security under changing climate regimes and assess the institutional safeguards required.

articles.title: Enhancing Maritime Domain Awareness in the Indian Ocean Region
articles.summary: India expands its Information Fusion Centre - Indian Ocean Region (IFC-IOR) network to bolster maritime safety and security.
prelims: IFC-IOR was established in 2018 in Gurugram to promote maritime security through real-time information sharing.
White Shipping Agreements facilitate the exchange of non-military commercial vessel traffic data between signatory nations.
Under UNCLOS, the Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) extends up to 200 nautical miles from a coastal state's baseline.
articles.mains: Discuss India's SAGAR (Security and Growth for All in the Region) vision in addressing traditional and non-traditional maritime challenges in the Indo-Pacific.
